data.title: Markets face a 'tug of war' between AI fundamentals and leverage: Allspring
data.description: Allspring Global Investments' Derrick Irwin says rising leverage and debt among Asian tech companies and US hyperscalers could potenially amplify the downside risks if bond yields rise and pressure mounts on the AI-driven capex boom.
